machine: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 threads, 16 GiB RAM, linux x86_64
note: Cloud VM class: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz under KVM, 16 GiB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.18, ext4 on a virtio disk, Rust 1.97, tmux 3.4. Only the scale metrics (benches/run.sh --scale-only), added with --extend-baseline on a quiet VM (nothing else running; load average under 0.4 at the start). Five runs of the same code (three with the page cache kept, two with it dropped) agreed within 10% on every best value kept here. scale.first_scan and scale.first_scan.first_session are not here: they are one sample that moved by 9% (the scan, 28.5 to 31.0 s with the page cache dropped) or 25% (the first session, polled every 100 ms) between runs, so they are checked against their budgets only. The four rss.* metrics are not here: they are over their 80 MiB budget, and --extend-baseline adds only metrics within theirs. Compare with: benches/run.sh --scale-only --baseline benches/baseline-cloud-vm.json
